blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly interpret social-media content, errors in their analysis may lend credibility to rumors and amplify their spread. In this paper, we study the problem of visual cognitive collusion, in which coordinated posts combine authentic images and locally faithful captions to induce VLM agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen target claims through their own reasoning. To enable systematic evaluation of this cognitive threat, we introduce a new benchmark comprising 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight application domains. We further propose VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework for simulating such attacks through narrative planning, image selection and ordering, and caption assignment under iterative review. We evaluate this threat through extensive experiments across 12 vision-language models, examining modality effects, production-team components, and downstream defenses. Using identical attack feeds across models without victim-specific optimization, we demonstrate cross-model transferability, achieving mean attack success rates of 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models. Moreover, 92.65% of generated feeds pass independent model-based validity auditing. Even after downstream review, residual attack success rates range from 35.3% to 76.7% across the evaluated configurations. Our additional controlled comparisons further reveal that captions can improve model-rated posting naturalness while reducing attack success. Together, these findings reveal a novel cognitive threat in social-media interpretation and motivate safeguards that assess how authentic posts jointly shape agents' reasoning and conclusions.
blocks.zh: 由于基于视觉语言模型(VLMs)的代理人越来越多地诠释社会-媒体内容,分析中的错误可能会为谣言提供可信度并扩大其传播. 在本文中,我们研究了视觉认知串通的问题,其中协调的帖子结合了真实的图像和当地忠实的字幕来诱导VLM代理通过自己的推理推断并接受攻击者选择目标的说法. 为了能够系统地评估这一认知威胁,我们引入了一个新的基准,包括544个目标案例和8个应用领域的33.2K候选图像。 我们进一步提出VisualMontage,这是一个多代理框架,通过叙述性规划、图像选择和订购以及迭代审查的标题任务来模拟这种攻击。 我们通过12种视觉语言模型的广泛实验来评估这种威胁,审查模式效应、生产团队组件和下游防御。 使用相同的攻击输入 跨模型 没有针对受害者的优化, 我们展示跨模型的可转移性, 实现平均攻击成功率 61.93% 对于专有模型和 68.71% 对于开放重量模型。 此外,92.65%的生成信息通过独立的基于模型的有效性审计。 即使经过下游审查,其余攻击成功率也从35.3%到76.7%不等。 我们额外的控制比较进一步表明,字幕可以改善模型评级的张贴自然性,同时减少攻击成功. 这些调查结果共同揭示了社会-媒体解释中的一种新的认知威胁,并激励了各种保障措施,这些保障措施评估了真实立场如何共同塑造代理人的推理和结论。

blocks.en: Social media provides open channels where rumors can emerge from unverified interpretations of events and spread widely through repeated sharing [ 55 ] . Across public affairs, science, and everyday social events, such rumors may distort judgments about what happened, who is responsible, and which sources deserve trust. Their influence can persist even after correction, allowing misinformation to continue shaping people’s reasoning [ 10 ] . This risk takes on an additional dimension as VLMs become the perceptual and reasoning core of agents that browse, interpret visual observations, and act on users’ behalf [ 29 , 16 , 24 , 57 ] . Consequently, an agent’s event summary or analysis may lend a rumor credibility and encourage further sharing by its users.
blocks.zh: 社交媒体提供公开的渠道,让谣言从未经核实的对事件的解读中产生出,并通过反复分享来广泛传播. [55]. 在公共事务、科学和日常社会活动中,这种谣言可能扭曲对所发生的事情、谁的责任和哪些来源值得信任的判断。 他们的影响力即使在改正后仍可持续, 由于VLM成为浏览、解释视觉观察和代表用户行事的代理人的感知和推理核心[29、16、24、57],这种风险又增加了一个层面。 因此,代理人的事件摘要或分析可能使人产生谣言的可信度,并鼓励其用户进一步分享。

blocks.en: This emerging social-media paradigm, where VLM agents serve as personal assistants [ 16 , 24 ] , can potentially be exploited by adversaries who jointly publish authentic images to the agents’ observable feeds through open channels. Authentic images can support misleading narratives when detached from their source context [ 34 , 1 ] . For example, photographs of residents waiting and a rescue boat departing may suggest abandonment when the intervening evacuation is omitted. Although each image remains unaltered and its caption faithfully describes what is visible, their combination possibly invites a conclusion contradicted by the full event. The agent’s analysis may then lend the rumor apparent visual support and credibility when shared with users. This cognitive threat arises when an agent combines individually faithful posts into a false interpretation of the event [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 这种新出现的社会媒体模式,即VLM代理担任个人助理[16,24],可能被对手利用,他们通过公开渠道向代理的可观察信息发布真实图像。 真实图像在脱离出自其源上下文时可以支持误导性叙事[34, 1]. 例如,居民等候和救援船离开的照片可能表明,在省略干预撤离时,会放弃。 虽然每个图像没有变化,其标题忠实地描述了可见的东西,但它们的组合可能会引起一个与整个事件相矛盾的结论. 代理商的分析可能会在与用户分享时提供流言显然的视觉支持和可信度. 这种认知威胁是当一个代理人将个人忠贞立场合并到对事件的错误解释中时产生的[19].

blocks.en: Compared with common attacks that disseminate fabricated images [ 49 , 26 , 22 ] , rely on steganographic collusion [ 42 ] , or activate preimplanted malicious associations or target outputs through backdoor triggers [ 28 , 35 , 32 ] , visual cognitive collusion in Figure 1 targets beliefs through coordinated selection, ordering, and presentation of authentic images with faithful captions. It requires neither hidden messages nor victim-model modification, while remaining difficult to mitigate because verifying individual posts cannot establish the validity of the relations inferred across them. Drawing on cognitive science and film theory [ 65 , 41 , 37 ] , we examine how recipients infer temporal, causal, or intentional relations across observations to construct a coherent event narrative. We formalize this threat by contrasting local factuality , the factual integrity of each post, with a global falsehood , an attacker-chosen claim contradicted by the source context but suggested by the combined feed.

blocks.en: To induce false beliefs from visual content, we propose VisualMontage , a multi-agent collusive framework with a Screenwriter for relational planning, a Visual Editor for image selection and ordering, and a Caption Editor for faithful captioning and presentation modes. Furthermore, the Director agent guides composition toward stronger belief in the global falsehood while balancing coherence and sequence length. A publication module places approved posts from coordinated publishers into the victim’s observable feed. Victim agents may then confidently accept and relay the falsehood to users, becoming unwitting amplifiers of rumor cascades across social networks.
blocks.zh: 为了从视觉内容中诱导出虚假的信仰,我们提议VisualMontage,一个多代理串联框架,一个用于关系规划的编剧,一个用于图像选择和订购的视觉编辑,以及一个用于忠实字幕和演示模式的字幕编辑。 此外,主任代理指导组成工作更加相信全球谬误,同时平衡一致性和序列长度。 一个出版单元将经核准的员额从协调出版商放入受害者可观察的饲料。 然后,受害者代理人可能自信地接受并向用户转发这些虚假信息,成为各种社交网络的谣言的无意放大器。

blocks.en: We conduct extensive simulation experiments with 12 VLMs across diverse domains, reusing feeds without victim-specific optimization. Mean attack success rate (ASR) reaches 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models, with mean reported confidence of 0.83 and 0.89 among false acceptances, respectively. Meanwhile, 92.65% of feeds pass independent validity auditing. These confidently wrong conclusions could cause cascading errors in downstream tasks, while our review and detection studies show limited protection. We further find that images alone outperform full-sequence feeds in our modality comparison, yet text makes social-media feeds more natural in model-based evaluations across multiple domains. Our work makes the following three contributions. • We formalize visual cognitive collusion through local factuality and global falsehood, and introduce a new benchmark with 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight domains. • We propose an automated multi-agent framework that coordinates narrative planning, visual composition, and faithful captioning through iterative review to induce false beliefs from authentic source material. • Across multiple VLMs from diverse model families, we characterize cross-model transferability, modality effects, production-team contributions, sequence length, construction cost, and the limits of downstream review and pre-exposure attack detection.
blocks.zh: 我们用12个不同领域的甚高频进行广泛的模拟实验,在不进行针对受害者的优化的情况下重新使用饲料。 专利型号的平均攻击成功率达到61.93%,开放重量型号达到68.71%,据报在虚假接受中,平均攻击成功率分别为0.83和0.89。 同时,92.65%的反馈通过独立有效性审计. 这些充满信心的错误结论可能在下游任务中造成连锁错误,而我们的审查和检测研究表明保护有限。 我们进一步发现,在我们的模式比较中,仅图像本身的绩效就超过了全部序列,然而文本却使社会媒体在跨多个领域基于模型的评价中更自然地提供信息。 我们的工作作出了以下三项贡献。 我们通过当地事实和全球谬误,正式确定视觉认知串通,并采用新的基准,包括544个目标案例和33.2K八个领域的候选图像。 我们提出一个自动化的多代理框架,通过迭代审查,协调叙事规划、视觉组成和忠实的字幕,以诱导来自真实来源材料的虚假信仰。 • 不同模式家庭的多种VLM,我们描述跨模式可转移性、模式效应、生产团队贡献、序列长度、建造成本以及下游审查和接触前攻击探测的限度。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Multimodal reasoning and agents. Visual instruction tuning [ 29 ] enables VLMs to follow image-grounded instructions. Agent systems generate executable visual programs [ 15 ] , retrieve video evidence [ 57 , 36 ] , and interact with websites [ 67 , 16 , 24 ] . These capabilities now support social-media assistants that answer public queries [ 39 ] and interpret shared photos in chats [ 40 , 51 ] . Such applications require models to connect observations with context. Benchmarks examine causal and compositional reasoning [ 63 , 60 , 13 ] , temporal understanding [ 25 , 11 ] , and integration of distributed evidence [ 7 ] . Evaluations of image–text composition and grounding further show that recognizing objects does not ensure correct interpretation [ 52 , 64 , 27 , 14 ] . While these studies assess reasoning over supplied evidence, we examine how adversaries actively select, order, and present authentic observations to induce false conclusions through the combined influence of locally factual posts.
blocks.zh: 多式联运推理和代理人。 视觉指令调制 [29] 使得VLMs能够遵循以图像为基础的指令. 代理系统生成可执行可视化程序[15],取回视频证据[57,36],并与网站[67,16,24]互动. 这些能力现在支持社会媒体助理回答公众询问[39],并在聊天中解释共享相片[40,51]. 这种应用需要模型将观测与上下文相连接. 基准审查因果关系和构成推理[63、60、13]、时间理解[25、11]以及所分发证据的整合[7]。 对图像-文字构成和基础的评估进一步表明,承认对象不能确保正确的解释[52、64、27、14]。 虽然这些研究评估了所提供证据的推理,但我们审查对手如何通过当地实际职位的综合影响积极挑选、排列和提出真实意见,以得出错误结论。

blocks.en: Adversarial manipulation of multimodal agents. Visual misinformation can give rumors apparent evidential support through fabricated imagery [ 49 , 26 ] or authentic images repurposed with misleading descriptions of people, places, and events [ 50 , 34 ] . This misuse of visual evidence has been studied in social-media image–text posts [ 8 , 45 ] and short-video misinformation [ 47 ] . Accordingly, defenses detect manipulated imagery [ 22 ] , check image–text consistency [ 48 ] , or recover source context through external evidence [ 1 , 53 ] . Their emphasis on detecting false content or mismatched context differs from our focus on misleading relations among locally factual posts. Figure 1 further distinguishes this threat from trigger-activated backdoors [ 28 , 35 , 32 ] or covert coordination through steganographic communication [ 42 ] . Cognitive collusion instead exploits the relations inferred across individually truthful observations to induce false beliefs. To our knowledge, we are the first to extend this idea to the visual domain and further evaluate how images and text, alone or together, affect attack success and posting naturalness.
blocks.zh: 横向操纵多式代理。 视觉错误信息可以通过捏造的图像[49、26]或对人员、地点和事件作出误导性描述的真实图像提供明显的证据支持[50、34]。 这种滥用视觉证据的现象在社会媒体形象-文本文章[8,45]和短视频误传[47]中被研究. 因此,辩护方检测被操纵的图像[22],检查图像-文本一致性[48],或通过外部证据恢复源上下文[1,53]。 他们强调发现虚假内容或不匹配的背景,这不同于我们注重当地事实立场之间的误导关系。 图1进一步区分了这种威胁与触发引爆后门[28、35、32]或通过素通信进行的秘密协调[42]。 相反,认知串通利用个人真实观察所推断的关系来诱发虚假的信仰。 据我们所知,我们首先将这一想法推广到视觉领域,并进一步评价图像和文本单独或一起如何影响攻击成功并张贴自然性。

blocks.en: We build the benchmark from public government recordings, news and social-media videos, and short films spanning the eight domains in Table 1 . Target-independent sampling at fixed intervals preserves images, source identifiers, and capture positions. A private source event graph records verified entities, actions, and relations; absent edges denote unknown relations. Across all domains, each candidate pool is paired with a target claim contradicted by verified source context, establishing its falsity independently of victim responses. We evaluate 544 declared source–target pairs, with 27–97 candidates per pool and 5–12 items per feed. Detailed corpus statistics and construction procedures appear in Table 9 and Appendix C.1 .

blocks.en: To assess the practical risk to user assistants, we simulate a VLM agent interpreting a social-media feed in response to a user’s verification request. Each victim receives the feed and question in a fresh context, returning a verdict, confidence, and rationale. The rationale captures the agent’s self-justification for its verdict, allowing us to examine how it argues for a false conclusion. We compare individual responses with strict-majority aggregation of repeated responses and with downstream judge review of the feed alone or together with victim reports [ 68 ] . Report-conditioned review models a downstream step in a misinformation cascade, testing whether an induced error is corrected or reinforced when another agent receives the victim’s conclusion and supporting rationale. Appendix A specifies aggregation, distinguishes vote fractions from self-reported confidence, and lists generation and auditing costs separately.

blocks.zh: 5.2 各种模型的认知脆弱性

blocks.en: To test whether the constructed feed changes a victim’s judgment, Table 2 compares VisualMontage with Source-order, Random-order, and No Evidence on the same source–target cases. The source-sampling controls measure selection and arrangement jointly, whereas claim-only queries measure false acceptance without the feed.
blocks.zh: 为了检验构建的饲料是否改变受害者的判断,表2将VisualMontage与源令、随机令和同一源-目标案件中的无证据进行比较。 源抽样控制对选择和安排进行联合衡量,而只要求查询则在没有种子的情况下对虚假接受进行衡量。

blocks.en: The same model-agnostic attack plans demonstrate cross-model transferability without victim-specific optimization, reaching mean ASRs of 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models. By comparison, both source-sampling controls average below 10%, while claim-only acceptance is lower still. Attack success across all 12 evaluated VLMs suggests a shared cognitive vulnerability in interpreting authentic visual evidence. Moreover, larger open-weight models do not consistently achieve lower ASR, indicating that scale alone is insufficient protection.
blocks.zh: 同样的模型不可知攻击计划显示出跨模型的可转移性,而没有针对受害者的优化,专利模型的平均ASR为61.93%,开放重量模型为68.71%。 相比之下,这两种来源抽样控制都平均低于10%,而仅要求接受的程度仍然较低。 在所有12个受评价的VLM中的攻击成功表明,在解释真实的视觉证据方面存在着共同的认知弱点。 此外,较大的开放重量模型不能一贯实现较低的ASR,表明单是规模是不够的。

blocks.en: This susceptibility persists when attack validity is assessed independently. Overall, 92.65% of feeds pass the audit, and mean V-ASR remains 56.89% and 63.28% for the two groups. Thus, the observed vulnerability extends to feeds passing checks on local factuality and isolated influence. The distinction matters for verification systems because individually defensible observations can still support a source-contradicted interpretation when presented together. Examples in Appendix C.4 contrast successful and failed interpretations of the composed evidence.
blocks.zh: 在独立评估攻击有效性时,这种易感性依然存在。 总体而言,92.65%的反馈通过审计,平均V-ASR仍为56.89%,两组为63.28%。 因此,观察到的脆弱性扩大到通过对当地实际情况和孤立影响的检查。 核查制度的区别很重要,因为个别可辩驳的观察仍然能够支持在一并提交时对源相冲突的解释。 附录C.4中的例子对比了对组成证据的成功和失败的解释。

blocks.en: Figure 3 and Table 2 highlight confident overinterpretation of authentic visual evidence. Mean confidence among false acceptances reaches 0.83 for proprietary models and 0.89 for open-weight models, while Qwen models retain high ASR at stringent confidence cutoffs. These results suggest that VLM agents infer unsupported relations between authentic observations and confidently endorse the resulting false narrative. This cognitive overreach makes reported confidence an unreliable indicator of factual correctness.
blocks.zh: 图3和表2突出了对真实视觉证据的自信过度解释。 虚假接受中的平均信任度为专有型有0.83分,开放重量型有0.89分,而Quen型则在严格的置信断时保留了高ASR. 这些结果表明,VLM代理人推断出真实观察之间缺乏支持的关系,并自信地认可由此产生的虚假叙述. 这种认知的过度普及使得所报信心成为真实正确性的不可靠指标.

blocks.en: 5.3 Vulnerability across source domains
blocks.zh: 5.3 源领域的脆弱性

blocks.en: The threat also spans the benchmark’s diverse visual settings. Table 3 reports ASR above 55% in every domain, with Emergency Response reaching 72.71%. Public Safety and Aerospace Operations are similarly susceptible, making the failure relevant to assistants interpreting consequential events. The benchmark therefore supports studying a shared interpretation failure across public-event recordings and fictional narratives, although these unadjusted domain averages do not isolate intrinsic differences in difficulty.
blocks.zh: 威胁还跨越了基准的不同视觉环境。 表3报告每个领域ASR高于55%,应急反应达到72.71%. 公共安全和航空航天业务同样容易发生,使故障与助理解释相应事件有关。 因此,该基准支持研究公共活动录音和虚构叙述的共同解释失败,尽管这些未经调整的域平均值并不孤立困难的内在差异.

blocks.en: Attack effectiveness and independent validity provide complementary views of this breadth. Emergency Response combines the highest domain ASR with 98.02% audit passage, showing that successful attacks can also satisfy the local checks. By contrast, Sports Training has a lower audit-pass rate despite similarly high acceptance. Reporting both outcomes avoids treating every persuasive sequence as a valid instance of the threat. Appendix C.9 provides relation-level results and discusses controlled domain comparisons.
blocks.zh: 攻击效力和独立有效性提供了对这一范围的补充观点。 应急反应将最高域ASR与98.02%的审计通道结合起来,表明成功出击也可以满足当地检查. 相比之下,体育培训的审计通过率较低,尽管接受率也很高。 报告这两种结果都避免将每个有说服力的序列视为威胁的有效实例。 附录C.9提供关系级结果并讨论可控域比较.

blocks.en: 5.4 Modality and component ablations
blocks.zh: 5.4 模式和组合

blocks.en: Table 4: Modality controls for GPT-5.6-luna on Aerospace Operations. Mean support averages confidence on acceptance and its complement on rejection, using valid responses. Appendix C.5 details both paired control experiments.
blocks.zh: 表4:对GPT-5.6-Luna的航空航天作业模式控制。 平均支持平均是对接受的信心以及对拒绝的补充,使用有效的答复。 附录C.5详细列出了两个对齐的控制实验.

blocks.en: Table 4 compares modalities under a fixed plan. Image-only exposure reaches 72.11% ASR, exceeding the complete feed’s 63.68%, whereas captions alone are less effective. Removing text also increases high-confidence acceptance. A plausible explanation is that faithful captions anchor visible referents and limit the misleading relations that images otherwise invite. Caption content has a smaller effect in the replacement control, where attack captions improve ASR over neutral descriptions by only 2.63 percentage points. These controls distinguish caption presence from content.
blocks.zh: 表4比较了固定计划下的方式。 只有图像曝光率达到了72.11%的ASR,超过了完整饲料的63.68 %,而光是标题效果则较差。 删除文本也提高了高信任度。 一个可信的解释是,忠实的字幕锁定了可见的参考者,并限制了图像在其他方面吸引的误导性关系。 Caption内容在替换控件中效果较小,攻击字幕比中性描述改进了ASR,只有2.63个百分点. 这些控件区分了标题存在和内容.

blocks.en: Table 5: Model-rated naturalness (%) over all evaluated feeds, scored by Claude Haiku 5.5. Domain abbreviations are AO (Aerospace Operations), IO (Industrial Operations), AR (Animal Rescue), and FA (Film & Animation).
blocks.zh: 表5:所有评价饲料的模型自然度(%),克洛德·海库5.5得分. 域名缩写为AO(Aerospace Operations),IO(工业操作),AR(动物救援),和FA(Film & Animation).

blocks.en: Nevertheless, attack success is only one requirement for plausible social-media exposure. Table 5 shows that adding captions improves model-rated posting naturalness in every evaluated domain. On Aerospace Operations, naturalness rises from 52.63% to 84.21%; the largest improvement occurs in Film & Animation. Together, these comparisons distinguish a caption’s contribution to misleading inference from its contribution to a familiar posting format.
blocks.zh: 然而,攻击成功只是社会媒体曝光的合理条件之一。 表5显示,增加标题可改善每个评价领域的模型评级张贴自然性。 在航空航天操作方面,自然率从52.63%上升到84.21%;电影和动画的改善最大。 这些比较共同区分了标题对误导推论的贡献和对熟悉的张贴格式的贡献。

blocks.en: Table 6: Construction ablations on Aerospace Operations with GPT-5.6-luna. Δ \Delta ASR measures the change in attack success relative to the full VisualMontage framework, expressed in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 表6:使用GPT-5.6-luna进行航空航天作业的施工。 QQ\Delta ASR 测量攻击成功率相对于完整VisualMontage框架的变化,以百分点表示.

blocks.en: The construction ablations in Table 6 reveal a related division of labor. Removing debate lowers ASR by 16.85 percentage points, while a single-agent editor and the variant without a Screenwriter also underperform the complete team. These gains support the value of coordinated planning and revision for composition. Conversely, removing the Caption Editor improves attack success, consistent with the modality comparison. Its presentation benefit must be evaluated separately from deceptive effectiveness. Appendix C.11 relates these gains to construction cost.
blocks.zh: 表6中的建筑工程显示出相关的分工。 移除争论会将ASR降低16.85个百分点,而单代理编辑器和没有编剧的变体也让整个团队表现不佳. 这些成果支持协调规划和修订构成的价值。 反之,去掉Caption编辑器可以提高攻击成功率,与模式比较一致. 其列报效益必须同欺骗效果分开评估。 附录C.11将这些收益与建筑费用挂钩。

blocks.en: Table 7: Malicious-feed detection on Sports Training with Claude Haiku 5.5. Inputs are an image, an image–caption record, or the full sequence. AUROC is area under the receiver operating characteristic curve; TPR and FPR are true- and false-positive rates. Res. is ASR after blocking flagged feeds; Calls are added calls per feed. Thresholds are fixed on development data. Appendix C.7 defines the metrics and treatment of failed responses.
blocks.zh: 表7:与克洛德·海库·5.5一起在体育训练中检测到的恶意行为。 输入是一个图像,一个图像 - 封装记录,或者完整的序列. AUROC是接收器操作特征曲线下的区域;TPR和FPR是真实和假阳性率. Res.是屏蔽被标记的种子后的 ASR; 调用每个种子都会被添加调用 。 阈值固定在开发数据上. 附录C.7界定了失败答复的衡量尺度和处理方法。

blocks.en: 5.5 Downstream review and attack detection
blocks.zh: 5.5 下游审查和攻击探测

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows that majority voting stays close to the first-response result across families, so repeated judgments over the same feed offer little protection. Judge review reduces acceptance more substantially, yet even the best evaluated configuration leaves roughly one third of attacks successful. These victim–judge comparisons show that agreement over a feed cannot replace verification against its source context.
blocks.zh: 图4显示,大多数投票仍然接近家庭的第一反应结果,因此对同一饲料的反复判断几乎没有提供多少保护。 法官审查更大幅度地减少了接受率,但即使得到最佳评价的配置也使大约三分之一的攻击成功。 这些受害者-法官的比较表明,对饲料的同意不能取代根据饲料来源进行的核查。

blocks.en: The controlled Emergency Response study in Table 11 reveals how errors can propagate between agents. A feed-only judge accepts 42.11% of targets initially rejected by the victim, offsetting its corrections. Adding victim confidence and rationales to verdicts only slightly reduces residual ASR, yet increases downstream HC-ASR from 30.56% to 68.06%. Richer reports thus leave fewer errors but more high-confidence false acceptances. A manipulated agent’s self-justification may turn it into an unwitting accomplice, lending credibility to the attacker’s narrative. This simulated transmission illustrates a potential pathway for misinformation cascades when downstream agents treat an upstream agent’s confident reasoning as independent corroboration.
blocks.zh: 表11中的受控应急研究揭示出误差如何在物剂之间传播. 只有消息的法官接受42.11%的最初被受害者拒绝的目标,抵消了它的改正. 在判决中增加受害者的信心和理由只是略为减少剩余ASR,而下游HC-ASR却从30.56%增加到68.06%. 因此,较丰富的报告留下了较少的错误,但更多的是高度信任的虚假接受。 被操纵的代理人的自我辩解可能使其变成无意的共犯,使攻击者的陈述具有可信度. 这种模拟传输表明,当下游代理人将上游代理人的自信推理视为独立佐证时,错误信息级联有可能出现。

blocks.en: Malicious-feed detection tests whether attacks can be blocked before reaching the victim. Table 7 shows near-chance ranking for image and image–caption inspection. Inspecting the complete sequence improves AUROC to 0.6304, but detects only 21.43% of attacks at a 9.52% test false-positive rate. This gain may partly reflect temporal inferences from timestamps, rather than recognition of deception in the content itself. Malicious and benign feeds can share authentic observations, leaving their intent difficult to distinguish through content inspection. Consequently, residual ASR remains 76.19% even with complete-sequence inspection. Appendix C.7 reports the detection–blocking tradeoffs.
blocks.zh: 恶意的检测测试在到达受害者之前是否可以阻止袭击。 表7显示图像和图像-封装检查的近距离排名。 检查完整的序列将AUROC改进为0.6304,但检测到的只有21.43%的攻击,测试率为9.52%的假阳性. 这一收益可能部分地反映了时间戳产生的时间推论,而不是内容本身对欺骗的承认. 恶意和良性饲料可以分享真实的观测结果,使其意图难以通过内容检查加以区分. 因此,即使经过完整的序列检查,剩余ASR仍为76.19%。 附录C.7报告了检测-阻断权衡。

blocks.en: Table 8: Effect of sequence length. Items and Tokens are counts; all other columns are percentages. Yield is completed feeds per attempt; Audit is their audit-pass rate. End-to-end valid ASR (E2E V-ASR) requires audit passage and majority false acceptance over all attempts. ASR and HC-ASR use five responses per feed; Tokens averages image-token counts per victim input. Full protocols and metric definitions appear in Appendices C.8 and C.11 .
blocks.zh: 表8:序列长度的影响。 物品和托肯是计数的;所有其他栏为百分比。 ield是每次尝试完成的反馈;审计是他们的审计通过率。 端到端有效的ASR(E2E V-ASR)要求审计通过,并对所有尝试进行多数虚假接受. ASR和HC-ASR使用每条饲料的5个响应;Tokens平均每个受害者输入的图像计数. 完整的协议和计量定义载于附录C.8和C.11。

blocks.en: 5.6 Sequence-length sensitivity
blocks.zh: 5.6 序列-长度敏感性

blocks.en: Table 8 shows that adding more items does not reliably strengthen the attack. Conditional ASR peaks at 15 items, yet only 9.86% of construction attempts produce an independently valid success. Six items achieve 33.90% under the same attempt-level accounting. The ranking therefore reverses when unsuccessful construction is retained, exposing the selection bias of judging length only on completed feeds.
blocks.zh: 表8显示,增加更多物品并不能可靠地加强攻击。 有条件的ASR峰值为15个项目,然而只有9.86%的施工尝试取得了独立有效的成功. 6个项目在同一尝试级核算下实现33.90%. 因此,如果保留不成功的构造,排名就会逆转,从而暴露出选择偏差,即只判断已完成的种子的长度。

blocks.en: Longer sequences consume more visual tokens and yield fewer valid feeds in this experiment. At 15 items, the mean image-token count exceeds twice that for six items, despite a lower valid success rate per attempt. Their added evidence may reinforce or disrupt the intended interpretation, so sequence length should be evaluated jointly with validity and construction yield. These results favor selective composition under the tested budget; they do not establish a universal optimal length. Appendix C.8 details the protocol; Appendix C.11 reports construction cost and convergence.
blocks.zh: 较长的序列会消耗更多的视觉符号,并在这一实验中产生较少的有效种子. 在15项中,平均图像计数超过6项的两倍,尽管每次尝试的有效成功率较低。 它们增加的证据可能强化或破坏预期的解释,因此序列长度应当与有效性和施工产量一并评估。 这些结果有利于在经过测试的预算下进行有选择的构成;它们没有规定普遍的最佳长度。 附录C.8详细介绍了协议;附录C.11报告了建筑成本和趋同情况.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce VisualMontageBench and a multimodal cognitive collusion attack that uses authentic images and locally faithful captions to manipulate VLM agents’ beliefs. Extensive simulations demonstrate cross-model transferability and confident false acceptance that persists through downstream review. These findings expose a gap between verifying individual posts and validating the conclusions drawn from them. In practical deployments, this gap could allow VLM assistants to lend credibility to misinformation and influence subsequent decisions, including in safety-critical settings. The resulting testbed supports further study of these risks and evaluation of safeguards that check inferred relations against source context. However, the evaluation remains limited to controlled simulations, leaving long-term effects in real social networks untested. We further discuss future directions for potential defense in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍VisualMontage Bench和多模式认知串通攻击,使用真实的图像和当地忠实的字幕来操纵VLM代理的信仰。 广泛的模拟表明,通过下游审查,交叉模式的可转让性和自信的虚假接受持续存在。 这些调查结果表明,在核实个别职位和核实从这些职位得出的结论之间存在着差距。 在实际部署中,这一缺口可能使虚拟LM助理能够为错误信息提供可信度并影响随后的决定,包括在安全关键环境下。 由此产生的试验台支持对这些风险作进一步研究并评价根据来源背景检查推断关系的保障措施。 然而,评价仍仅限于有控制的模拟,使真实社交网络的长期影响没有经过测试. 我们在附录D中进一步讨论未来可能的防御方向。

blocks.en: This appendix expands the construction and evaluation interfaces summarized in the main paper. The studio uses prompt-defined roles with separate decision variables, and all public feeds are produced locally under a fixed protocol for rendering records and assigning publication metadata.

blocks.en: Source preparation separates the event record from the observations that will become public. Let 𝒩 src \mathcal{N}_{\mathrm{src}} denote the events or entities identified in the verified source context, and let ℰ src \mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{src}} denote their labeled temporal, spatial, and other verified relations. The source event graph 𝒢 src = ( 𝒩 src , ℰ src ) \mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{src}}=(\mathcal{N}_{\mathrm{src}},\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{src}}) provides a reference for interpreting what the original observations depict. Structured video annotations in STAR and MovieGraphs motivate this source-level representation [ 58 , 54 ] . A missing edge leaves a relation unresolved unless the source provides evidence against it, consistent with the truth labels in Sec. 3 . The reference thus distinguishes verified falsehood from incomplete knowledge of the underlying event being depicted.

blocks.en: The decomposition can reduce construction effort because each editor refines a specific decision space. A screenplay specifies intended relations, the Visual Editor selects and orders evidence to support the target, and the accepted sequence provides captioning with a stable context. A complete-sequence proposal can reconsider both length and order in one round, while Director feedback targets the relation or local constraint that made the previous composition inadequate. These properties explain the bounded-call design. Comparing attack quality at matched budgets then tests whether the decomposition improves the use of available computation.

blocks.en: The Visual Editor evaluates candidate sequences throughout the prescribed revision budget and selects the highest-ranked sequence accepted by the Director. Here, acceptance indicates that a candidate satisfies the construction criteria, while final selection occurs after refinement is complete. Caption editing then preserves the selected images and their order. Further rounds may find a more effective candidate, but repeated optimization against the Director can also favor proposals that fail an independent audit. A budget study should therefore track valid victim success alongside Director acceptance, distinguishing the cost of finding a plausible composition from the cost of constructing an independently verified attack.

blocks.en: The full-feed condition establishes whether the victim accepts the target. Both measured source-video references resample frames: Source-order presents them chronologically, whereas Random-order shuffles them. Their comparisons with montage therefore measure broader composition differences. A separate fixed-content permutation control can isolate order within selected records, while the evidence-free condition measures prior false acceptance. Whole-feed modality ablations test cross-modal contribution, and single-record projections test whether a locally dominant clue explains the result. Each comparison must specify which editing decisions it changes and preserve the remaining prompt, rendering, and publication-metadata conditions across presentations.

blocks.en: Distribution through multiple publishers also requires a matched control. Holding record content and order fixed while changing the attributed publisher tests whether apparent source multiplicity affects the victim’s judgment. Downstream-report controls similarly distinguish direct influence from the feed and additional influence from the victims’ conclusions. Together with source-aligned relation analysis and call, token, and latency accounting, these comparisons connect the social-media scenario to measurable cognitive errors. Simulated exposure, recommendations to share, and further dissemination remain distinct outcomes.

blocks.en: Responsibility can be distributed across records without being distributed across modalities. A sequence of images may collectively support the target even when each image is inconclusive, while adding captions may contribute little. Conversely, a faithful caption can anchor a referent and change how the neighboring visual evidence is interpreted. The distinction matters because local compliance alone does not establish multimodal complementarity. Unimodal shortcuts in misinformation benchmarks further motivate measuring the contribution of each modality explicitly [ 45 ] .

We build the evaluation corpus from publicly accessible videos collected from the Internet.
Most real-world recordings come from public-domain U.S. government archives (the Defense Visual Information Distribution Service and Wikimedia Commons). The rest are publicly released news and social-media videos, and the Film & Animation domain uses openly released short films.
The source recordings retain their original visual content without image synthesis or video editing.
Each video becomes a candidate evidence pool through deterministic sampling at a fixed interval. A single FFmpeg pass extracts frames at timestamps 0 , Δ frame , 2 ​ Δ frame , … 0,\Delta_{\mathrm{frame}},2\Delta_{\mathrm{frame}},\dots , where each video has its own Δ frame \Delta_{\mathrm{frame}} of 1–10 s chosen from its duration. No semantic filtering, ranking, or manual selection is applied.
For each source video, we then declare target claims h f h_{\mathrm{f}} . Each target is required to be false under the verified source context, while the selected visual evidence must preserve its original content.

blocks.en: The evaluated panel contains 12 VLMs from four model families. The proprietary group consists of GPT-6-sol, GPT-6-luna, GPT-5.6-terra, GPT-5.6-luna, Claude-haiku-5-5, and Claude-sonnet-5-5. The open-weight group contains Qwen3-VL-4B-Inst, Qwen3-VL-8B-Inst, Qwen3-VL-32B-Inst, InternVL3.5-8B, InternVL3.5-14B, and InternVL3.5-38B. The main paper reports per-model results and unweighted group averages in Table 2 . Exact checkpoint or service snapshot identifiers, reasoning settings, and evaluation dates should be reported with the released evaluation records. The same frozen attack feeds are presented to every victim under the same claim-verification question, publication schedule, image-resolution policy, and response schema. blocks.en: For each case, the model receives only the same target proposition, decision instruction, and response schema in a fresh context. It receives no images, captions, posts, publisher names, publication times, source context, or previous conversation. For a source-verified false target such as “an accident occurred during the launch,” the model is asked whether that proposition is true without being shown the launch recording or its extracted images. blocks.en: Additional analyses can report matched-order gain, cross-record gap, and source-verified relation errors using the diagnostics in Appendix B . Beyond the measured sampling references, a caption-controlled construction baseline could pair randomly sampled frames with faithful neutral captions, matching sequence length and candidate pool. A complementary comparison may include a balanced benign claim-verification set with both true and false targets, measuring ordinary reasoning accuracy under source-faithful presentation. Open-weight and proprietary groups are descriptive categories, not a controlled intervention on model access policies or reasoning reliability.

blocks.en: The optional support-score diagnostic in Eq. ( 18 ) instead requires permutations of fixed attack-selected records. Its expectation can be estimated by averaging such permutations per case, then averaging across cases. It is distinct from the acceptance-rate gain in Eq. ( 27 ). Score comparisons require valid confidence for every paired input and report the common subset’s coverage, without removing missing-confidence cases from the ASR denominator. Benign accuracy counts explicit correct binary verdicts over all benign cases; abstentions and failures remain visible in separate status columns.

blocks.en:
Authentic evidence can support
conflicting interpretations through reordering. As illustrated in Fig. 5 , the source-order and adversarial sequences contain identical visual observations but elicit different judgments from the victim model. The successful and unsuccessful cases further highlight the variability of this effect, showing that adversarial composition can induce false acceptance without guaranteeing success in every instance.
blocks.zh:
真实证据可以支持
通过重排顺序进行相互矛盾的解释. 如图5所说明的,源令和对抗序列包含相同的视觉观察,但引起与受害人模式不同的判断。 成功和不成功的案例进一步凸显出这种效应的可变性,表明对抗性成分可能诱发虚假的接受,而不保证在每一个情况下都取得成功。

blocks.en: Figure 5 illustrates both successful and unsuccessful compositions. Placing fire and smoke after flight images invites an explosion narrative in the first case. In the second, the victim questions whether the observations establish the claimed identity, event, and action, despite their suggestive order. These contrasting responses contextualize the aggregate results, although their rationales do not establish the models’ internal reasoning mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 图5显示成功和失败的构成。 在飞行画面后放出火和烟会请来第一起爆炸叙事. 第二起,受害者质疑,尽管有暗示性命令,但意见是否确定了声称的身份、事件和行动。 这些对比性的答复将总体结果放在了上下文中,尽管它们的理由并没有确定模型的内部推理机制。

blocks.en: C.5 Contribution of visual and textual evidence
blocks.zh: C.5 视觉和文字证据的贡献

blocks.en: Do captions increase vulnerability beyond the selected images, and does the combined feed contribute more than either modality alone? The primary comparison freezes each published feed and removes only its publicly visible captions or images, following Eq. ( 20 ). Caption removal uses the original decoded images before any overlay is drawn, so erased text does not leave visual artifacts. Empty publication slots are preserved, and an image privately associated with a text-only post is never revealed by the image-only projection. This makes the full-feed comparison a controlled test of the information that the victim can actually observe.
blocks.zh: 标题是否在选定的图像之外增加脆弱性,合并的种子对两种模式的贡献是否更大? 主比较冻结每个已公布的种子,并仅删除其公开可见的标题或图像,沿用Eq. (20.). 标题去除在绘制出任何覆盖之前使用原始已解码的图像,因此被去除的文本不会留下视觉文物. 空出出版插槽被保留,一个与只文本帖相关的私下图像从不由只图像投影显示. 这使得全素的比对成为了对被害者能够实际观察到的信息的控制测试.

blocks.en: To study caption content separately from its presence, a second paired comparison replaces the attack captions with independently written neutral descriptions of the same images, matched for factual scope and approximate length. Selection, order, modes, and publication metadata remain fixed. For originally paired records, a focused image-versus-image-plus-caption analysis is also reported on their shared subset. Cross-modal gain is measured per case, together with its distribution and the fraction of cases with positive gain; an increase in aggregate ASR alone does not establish that both modalities were necessary for individual attacks.
blocks.zh: 为了单独研究标题内容和存在内容,用独立写成的相同图像的中性描述来取而代之的第二个对齐比较,与事实范围和大致长度相匹配。 选择、顺序、模式和出版元数据保持不变。 对于最初配对的记录,还在其共享子集上报告了重点图像与图像加封装分析。 跨模式收益是按个案衡量的,连同其分布情况和有正收益的个案的分数;单凭ASR总量的增加并不能确定两种模式都是个人攻击所必须的.

blocks.en: In each case, cross-modal gain is the full feed’s support minus the larger support from the image-only and caption-only projections, as in Eq. ( 20 ). Subtracting the same evidence-free support from all three scores cancels in this difference. Average the per-case gains and count how many are positive; do not subtract the maximum of two dataset means. The cross-record gap similarly subtracts the strongest isolated-record support from full-feed support, with each isolated record queried separately and the maximum taken within its own case.
blocks.zh: 在每一种情况下,跨模式收益是完全饲料的支持减去仅图像和标题的预测中更大的支持,如Eq. (20)。 从所有三个分数中减去相同的无证据支持,就取消了这一差异. 平均每例增益并计出正数;不要减去两个数据集的最大值。 交叉记录的空白同样将最强的单独记录支持从全食支持中扣除,每个单独记录都单独询问,并在自己的情况下采取最大程度.

blocks.en: VisualMontage supports image-only, caption-only, and image–caption posts; the frozen-feed controls isolate which published evidence is visible. As shown in Table 4 , the image-only projection achieves an ASR of 72.11%, outperforming the published mixed feed (63.68%) and the caption-only condition (41.58%). The advantage is more pronounced in high-confidence attack success, where the image-only condition reaches 69.47% HC-ASR, compared with 48.42% for the mixed feed. These results suggest that visual composition alone can induce substantial false acceptance, while additional textual evidence does not necessarily strengthen the misleading interpretation.
blocks.zh: 视觉 Montage 支持只显示图像、只显示标题和图像 - caption 帖; 显示已公布证据的被冻结的控件隔离 。 如表4所示,仅图像投影达到72.11%的ASR,优于公布的混合饲料(63.68%)和仅字幕条件(41.58%)。 这一优势在高自信攻击成功方面更为明显,仅图像条件达到69.47%的HC-ASR,而混合饲料则达到48.42%. 这些结果表明,光是视觉成分就可能诱发大量虚假的接受,而额外的文字证据并不一定会加强误导性的解释.

blocks.en:
Attack effectiveness and presentation
naturalness do not always align. To reflect realistic social-media posting practices, VisualMontage also supports image–caption sequences, which are favored over image-only posts in the model-based naturalness assessment. Although captioned posts achieve lower ASR, they offer a more natural form of evidence presentation. Furthermore, replacing neutral captions with attack-oriented captions increases ASR from 61.05% to 63.68%, a modest gain of 2.63 percentage points. These findings highlight a trade-off between deceptive effectiveness and presentation naturalness, motivating separate evaluation of attack effectiveness and the naturalness of the resulting posts from the receiving agent’s perspective.
blocks.zh:
攻击效果和表述
自然并不总是一致的。 VisualMontage 也支持图像封装序列, 虽然有标题的帖子实现了较低的ASR,但它们提供了更自然的证据展示形式. 此外,用面向攻击的字幕取而代之的是中性字幕,将ASR从61.05%提高到63.68%,略有增益2.63个百分点。 这些调查结果突出了欺骗效力与列报自然性之间的取舍,促使从接收方的角度对攻击效力和由此产生的员额自然性进行单独评价。

blocks.en: Can a downstream judge reject the false conclusion after a victim has accepted it? A fixed defensive judge is evaluated on the feed alone, the feed with victim verdicts, and the feed with verdicts and rationales. The same judge checkpoint and instruction are used across these input conditions. The defense instruction asks it to assess whether the supplied evidence warrants the target claim; it does not reveal source labels, the screenplay, or the attack-generation trace. A separate source-context condition may measure the benefit of additional evidence, but is identified as a stronger-information diagnostic rather than the default threat model.
blocks.zh: 下游法官能否在受害人接受错误结论后驳回这一结论? 固定的防守法官仅由饲料上评价,有受害者判决的饲料上评价,有判决和理由的饲料上评价. 同一法官检查站和指示适用于这些输入条件。 辩护方指示要求它评估所提供的证据是否值得提出目标索赔;它没有披露源标签,剧本,或攻击生成的痕迹. 单独的源代码条件可以衡量额外证据的好处,但被确定为更强的信息诊断,而不是默认的威胁模型.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 11 , strict majority voting increases ASR from 73.61% to 79.17%, recovering only 3.77% of initial false acceptances. Similarly, a feed-only judge retains an ASR of 73.61% while introducing new false acceptances in 42.11% of initially rejected cases. These results suggest that additional judgments do not necessarily mitigate adversarial misinterpretations.

blocks.en: Providing victim verdicts reduces residual ASR to 69.44% and HC-ASR to 30.56%. However, adding confidence scores and rationales only marginally lowers residual ASR to 68.06%, while HC-ASR increases to 68.06%. This contrast highlights the limited reliability of downstream reasoning under the evaluated configurations for reviewing adversarially composed authentic evidence.
blocks.zh: 做出受害人判决后,剩余ASR降至69.44%,HC-ASR降至30.56%。 然而,增加信心分数和理由只会将剩余ASR略降至68.06%,而HC-ASR则增至68.06%。 这一对比凸显出,在评价的组合下审查对抗性由真实证据构成的下游推理的可靠性有限。

blocks.en: C.7 Malicious-feed detection
blocks.zh: C.7 恶意饲料检测

blocks.en: Can a defensive agent identify adversarial use of authentic images before forwarding them to the victim? We compare an image-only detector, an isolated-record detector, and a sequence-aware detector. Each produces a suspicion score under a fixed instruction; its threshold is chosen on development data to achieve a target benign false-positive rate ξ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \xi\in[0,1] . Test attacks are paired with benign presentations from the same sources, controlling length, visual content, caption style, and publisher metadata where possible. The same image may occur in both classes, so the label concerns its use in a composition rather than a property of the pixels of any one image considered in isolation.

blocks.en: Both recovery from initial false acceptance and new false acceptance introduced after an initially correct rejection are reported. These transitions distinguish useful correction from the amplification of another agent’s mistake. For majority aggregation, the number and identity of victim runs are fixed and their individual outcomes are recorded; vote fraction is not interchangeable with a model’s self-reported confidence. Invalid responses and abstentions are separate outcomes rather than confirmed rejections. The first evaluation uses frozen attacks, with any later adaptation to a known defense reported with a separate budget and a fixed protocol describing which defense information is exposed.
blocks.zh: 最初的虚假接受和最初正确的拒绝后引入的新虚假接受均报告收回。 这些转变将有益的纠正与扩大另一个代理人的错误区分开来。 就多数人而言,受害者人数和身份是固定的,他们个人的结果是记录下来的;表决的分数不能与模型的自报信心相交换。 无效的答复和弃权是单独的结果,而不是确认的拒绝。 第一次评估采用被冻结的攻击,以后对已知的辩护的任何修改都报告有单独的预算和固定的协议,说明哪些辩护信息被曝光。

blocks.en: For each judge row, HC-ASR uses that judge’s own verdict and confidence in Eq. ( 23 ), with the same threshold and denominator B B . Majority voting follows Eq. ( 8 ); its winning vote fraction is not substituted for confidence in HC-ASR. All transition comparisons use the same initial victim response for each case. The full-report condition supplies verdicts, confidences, and rationales, while the verdict-only condition withholds confidences and rationales to measure how those reports affect the final judgment.

blocks.en: Local authenticity checks do not reliably expose malicious composition. As shown in Table 7 , image-level and record-level detectors achieve AUROCs of 0.5091 and 0.5094, respectively, with residual ASR of 80.95% in both cases. These results are consistent with near-random discrimination of attack and benign presentations.
blocks.zh: 本地真实性检查不可靠地暴露出恶意成分. 如表7所示,图像级和记录级的探测器分别达到0.5091和0.5094的AUROC,其余的ASR为80.95%。 这些结果与攻击和良性陈述的近乎随机的歧视是一致的。

blocks.en: Sequence awareness helps, but substantial risk remains. The complete-feed detector increases AUROC to 0.6304 and TPR to 21.43% at a test FPR of 9.52%, reducing residual ASR to 76.19%. It also uses 1.00 additional call per feed, versus 5.48–5.74 for local detectors. The improvement is therefore modest at the tested operating point.

blocks.en: C.8 Sequence-length sensitivity
blocks.zh: C.8 序列长度敏感性

blocks.en: Table 8 in the main paper reports the measured sweep. Length counts sequence items, including text-only items. Mean victim image tokens are reconstructed offline per evaluated feed using the original checkpoint processor and the same resolution policy. The analysis distinguishes conditional ASR from valid construction reliability.
blocks.zh: 主文件中的表8报告了测量的扫荡情况。 长度计算序列项, 包括仅文本项 。 利用原来的检查站处理器和同一解析政策,每条评估的种子重建平均受害者图像标志。 分析区分了有条件的ASR和有效构造可靠性.

blocks.en: Does adding more authentic frames strengthen the attack, or does its effect saturate or reverse? The length sweep varies K K over a prespecified feasible range while holding the source–target cohort, candidate pool size N N , image resolution, and construction budget fixed. At each length, plans are reconstructed under identical constraints, with failed constructions retained in the accounting. This tests the achievable attack quality at a given length. A complementary within-plan analysis, once measured, would add or remove records under a prespecified rule to distinguish additional evidence from rerunning the search.
blocks.zh: 添加更真实的帧会加强攻击,还是其效果会饱和或倒置? 长度扫描在预先指定的可行范围内的 K K 上不尽相同, 同时持有源 - 目标组群, 候选池大小 N N , 图像分辨率和建筑预算 固定 。 每个长度的计划都是在相同的限制下重建的,在会计中保留了失败的建筑. 这测试了在一定长度内可实现的攻击质量. 一项补充性的计划内分析一旦得到衡量,将根据预先规定的规则增加或去除记录,以区分额外证据和重新进行搜索。

blocks.en: The primary sweep reports end-to-end valid success alongside conditional ASR so that a length with poor construction yield cannot appear effective merely by retaining a small successful subset. The protocol audits selected records at each length and records truncation or context-limit failures separately. A planned secondary fixed-total-visual-token comparison would examine the tradeoff between frame count and per-frame detail; it is kept separate from the primary fixed-resolution sweep. Paired comparisons would quantify uncertainty in the effect of adding frames, without presuming that each additional item strengthens the resulting attack.
blocks.zh: 初级扫描报告与有条件的ASR一道,最终有效成功,因此,只要保留一个小的成功子集,建筑收益率低的长度就不能显得有效。 协议对每个长度的选定记录进行审核,并分别记录截取或上下文限制故障. 计划进行的二级固定式全视化比较将审查帧计数与每帧细节之间的取舍;它与主要固定分辨率扫描分开。 平分比较可以量化添加帧效果的不确定性,而不会假定每个附加项目会强化由此而来的攻击.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 8 , ASR varies non-monotonically with sequence length, increasing from 59.39% at K = 3 K=3 to a peak of 72.50% at K = 15 K=15 , before declining to 56.25% at K = 20 K=20 . High-confidence attack success follows a similar trend. These results suggest that excessive evidence may introduce redundant or conflicting cues, potentially weakening the misleading narrative as the selected sequence grows longer.
blocks.zh: 如表8所示,ASR随序列长度而变化,从K=3K=3的59.39%增加到K=15K=15的72.50%的峰值,再下降到K=20K=20的56.25%. 高自信攻击的成功也遵循类似趋势。 这些结果表明,过多的证据可能会引入多余或相冲突的提示,随着所选序列的延长,可能会削弱误导性叙述。

blocks.en: Despite achieving the highest conditional ASR, K = 15 K=15 yields only 9.86% E2E V-ASR, with a construction yield of 22.54% and an audit pass rate of 62.50%. In contrast, K = 6 K=6 achieves the highest E2E V-ASR of 33.90%, alongside a 93.94% audit pass rate. Consistently, VisualMontage generates sequences of 5–12 items across 544 evaluated cases despite a configured range of 5–30, as shown in Table 9 . These findings suggest that effective evidence composition favors selectivity over length, balancing conditional attack success against the probability of producing a valid sequence.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了最高的ASR,K=15K=15的产量仅为9.86%的E2E V-ASR,建筑收益为22.54%,审计合格率为62.50%. 相形之下,K=6K=6实现了最高的E2E V-ASR为33.90%,加上93.94%的审计通过率. 始终如一地,VisualMontage在544个评价案件中产生5至12个物品的序列,尽管配置范围为5至30个,见表9。 这些调查结果表明,有效的证据构成有利于选择长度,平衡了有条件的攻击成功与产生有效序列的可能性。

blocks.en: C.9 Domain and relation analysis
blocks.zh: C.9 领域和关系分析

blocks.en: Table 3 presents the full domain-level comparison in the main paper. Here we describe its interpretation and retain the finer domain-by-relation visualizations.
blocks.zh: 表3列示了主论文中完整域级的比较. 在这里,我们描述了它的诠释,并保留了更细的逐个关系可视化域.

blocks.en: Are news and public-event sources more susceptible to deceptive composition than film narratives? The domain comparison uses the same victim panel, construction policy, and audit criteria. A matched follow-up would stratify source duration, candidate pool size, selected length, caption length, target relation type, and evidence-free target support. Targets involving temporal order, causation, intent, identity, or co-location are annotated consistently across domains. News and film sources may differ in editing style and background context, so the reported unadjusted domain averages do not establish a matched domain effect.
blocks.zh: 新闻和公共活动来源是否比电影叙事更容易受到欺骗性成分的影响? 域比较采用同样的受害人小组、施工政策和审计标准。 与之相匹配的后续行动将分清源的持续时间、候选集合大小、选定的长度、标题长度、目标关系类型和无证据目标支持。 涉及时间顺序、因果关系、意图、身份或合用同一地点的目标在各领域都有一致的说明。 新闻和电影来源在编辑风格和背景背景上下文可能有所不同,因此所报道的未调整域平均值没有建立匹配域效应.

blocks.en: Adversarial composition remains effective across diverse source domains. As shown in Table 3 , domain-level ASR ranges from 55.30% for Industrial Operations to 72.71% for Emergency Response. Film and Animation reaches 64.96%, although its audit pass rate is 84.21%, compared with 98.02% for Emergency Response. These descriptive differences alone do not establish an intrinsic news–film vulnerability gap without matched controls.
blocks.zh: 各种来源领域的横向构成依然有效。 如表3所示,域级ASR从工业业务的55.30%到应急反应的72.71%不等。 电影和动画达到64.96%,尽管其审计通过率为84.21%,而应急反应为98.02%。 仅凭这些描述性差异并不能在缺乏相匹配的控制的情况下确定固有的新闻-电影脆弱性差距。

blocks.en: Two follow-up controls are planned to test explanations that an overall domain gap cannot resolve. First, we would anonymize publisher identities and compare posts attributed to one publisher with posts attributed to several, holding content, order, and display times fixed; this isolates the effect of apparent publisher multiplicity. Second, we would restore verified source context under a separately labeled condition to test whether missing context explains the error. For films, context restoration concerns the narrative’s events rather than external-world truth. These interventions would connect the social-media setting to measurable recipient behavior while keeping claims about diffusion and public opinion separate from the recipient’s observed responses.
blocks.zh: 计划进行两项后续控制,以测试总体域间隙无法解决的解释。 首先,我们将对出版商的身份进行匿名化,并将一个出版商的帖子与几个出版商的帖子进行比较,固定内容、顺序和显示时间;这隔离了出版商的明显多样性的影响。 其次,我们会在一个单独标签的条件下恢复已核实的源上下文,以测试缺失上下文是否解释错误. 对于电影来说,背景恢复涉及叙事事件而不是外部世界的真相. 这些干预措施将把社会媒体环境与可衡量受援者的行为联系起来,同时将关于传播和公众舆论的主张与受援者的观察反应分开。

blocks.en: Each domain’s reported rates are computed from its own source–target cases under the definitions above. A model macro average gives each evaluated victim equal weight; a domain macro average gives each domain equal weight, rather than pooling unequal sample counts. Future matched news–film differences would use the same matching strata and victim identities, with rates differenced in percentage points. For the relation-error heatmaps, each cell is intended to report the fraction of audited responses asserting at least one source-verified false relation of that type. The denominator contains responses with sufficient source evidence to adjudicate that type; unresolved annotations and unparseable responses are counted separately with both counts and annotation coverage reported for every cell.

blocks.en: C.10 Production-team component ablation

blocks.en: Which components contribute to successful attack construction? Table 6 reports the complete production-team ablation as a standalone table in the main paper. blocks.en: Removing the debate mechanism reduces ASR from 63.68% to 46.83%, while replacing the production team with a single agent yields 48.50%. Removing the Screenwriter also lowers ASR to 57.50%. These comparisons support the importance of coordinated construction under the fixed victim and source-domain configuration evaluated on the Aerospace Operations recordings.

blocks.en: More components do not always improve attack effectiveness. Removing the Caption Editor increases ASR from 63.68% to 70.73% and HC-ASR from 48.42% to 64.88%. Thus, the Caption Editor cannot be claimed to improve attack success in the present ablation. However, the naturalness assessment in Table 5 shows rates of 84.21% for image–caption feeds and 52.63% for image-only feeds on the same domain. blocks.en: C.11 Efficiency of coordinated construction
blocks.zh: 页:1 协调施工的效率

blocks.en: We evaluate the construction efficiency of VisualMontage against two baselines: a single-agent editor and independent proposals. All methods operate on identical candidate pools, target claims, and factual constraints under matched construction budgets. Generation calls, retries, rejected proposals, and unsuccessful attempts are included in the accounting to ensure a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们根据两个基线来评价VisualMontage的建造效率:一个单一代理编辑器和一个独立的建议. 所有方法都适用于相同的候选人才库、目标索偿以及相应的建筑预算下的事实制约。 代代相传、复议、否决建议和不成功的尝试都纳入会计,以确保公平比较。

blocks.en: Coordination buys higher success at additional cost. The efficiency experiment reports 54.44% end-to-end valid success for VisualMontage, compared with 38.89% for a single editor and 40.00% for independent proposals (Table 12 ). However, generation cost per valid success is also higher: 1.2502 versus 0.3151 and 0.9541 on the reported cost scale. The mean stage-round counts are 2.90, 2.73, and 2.60 for screenplay, visual, and caption editing. Thus bounded revision makes the expenditure explicit, but the measured advantage is greater success rather than lower cost.

blocks.en: Appendix D Discussion: Ethical Considerations and Potential Defenses
blocks.zh: 附录D 讨论:道德考虑和可能的辩护

blocks.en: Although this work studies visual cognitive collusion through controlled simulations to support safer VLM agents for research purpose, the attack framework could also be misused to spread rumors or manipulate decisions. In particular, authentic images can be recombined into misleading feeds that harm people depicted in the source material and users who rely on an agent’s conclusions. Confident false interpretations may further amplify these harms when passed to downstream systems. These dual-use risks motivate future work on potential defense strategies that verify inferred relations and limit the persistence and propagation of false beliefs. The following four directions outline possible safeguards, whose effectiveness against visual cognitive collusion remains to be established through systematic empirical evaluation.
blocks.zh: 虽然本作通过可控模拟来研究视觉认知串通,为研究目的支持更安全的VLM剂,但攻击框架也可能被滥用来传播谣言或操纵决定. 特别是,真实的图像可以重新组合成误导性素材,伤害源材料所描绘的人和依赖代理人结论的用户。 相信错误的解释可能会在转移到下游系统时进一步加剧这些危害。 这些双重用途风险促使今后就潜在的防卫战略开展工作,以核实推断的关系并限制虚假信仰的持续存在和传播。 以下四个方向概述了可能的保障措施,其防止视觉认知串通的有效性仍有待通过系统的经验性评估来确立。

blocks.en: First, evidence-grounded verification could assess the relations inferred across posts alongside the authenticity of each image. Retrieval and contextual verification could reconnect a feed to its original sources, providing evidence for checking the chronology, identity, and causal relations assumed in an interpretation [ 48 , 53 ] . Neuro-symbolic methods offer a complementary way to connect learned visual representations with explicit reasoning rules and logical verification [ 38 , 2 , 3 ] . Applied to our setting, such a defense could distinguish visible observations from inferred relations and withhold conclusions whose premises lack adequate support. Reliable grounding remains essential, since logical consistency cannot establish that extracted premises are true or complete. Verification should therefore preserve uncertainty and seek evidence beyond the potentially misleading feed whenever reliable source context is available.
blocks.zh: 首先,有证据依据的核查可以评估各哨所间推断的关系以及每个图像的真实性。 检索和背景核查可以重新连接原始来源的种子,为检查解释中假设的编年、身份和因果关系提供证据[48、53]。 神经-同义方法为将所学到的视觉表现与明确的推理规则和逻辑验证[38, 2, 3]联系起来提供了一种补充方式. 根据我们的背景,这种辩护可以区分明显的观察和推断的关系,并保留其前提缺乏足够支持的结论。 可靠的地基定位仍然至关重要,因为逻辑上的一致性不能确定所提取的房地是否真实或完整。 因此,只要有可靠的来源背景,核查就应保持不确定性并寻找可能误导性的证据。

blocks.en: Second, adversarial testing could identify fragile judgments and guide defensive interventions. Efficient robustness testing and multimodal attack evaluation provide foundations for probing sensitivity to controlled input changes [ 20 , 61 ] , while test-time counterperturbations suggest a complementary route to resisting manipulation [ 62 ] . For collusive feeds, a promising direction is to test whether perturbations that preserve claim-relevant evidence can disrupt misleading associations or expose unwarranted confidence. Inconsistent judgments could trigger source verification or a cautious response. Such interventions require evaluation against adaptive attacks and benign feeds, since stability alone cannot establish that a conclusion is correct.
blocks.zh: 第二,对抗性测试可确定脆弱的判断并指导防御性干预。 高效的稳健度测试和多模式攻击评价为测试受控输入变化的敏感性提供了基础[20,61],而测试时间反扰则暗示了抵制操纵的补充路径[62]. 对于串通饲料而言,一个很有希望的方向是检验保存与索赔有关证据的扰动是否会破坏误导性协会或暴露不必要的信任。 不一致的判断可能触发源核查或谨慎的反应。 这种干预措施需要针对适应性攻击和良性饲料进行评价,因为仅靠稳定不能确定结论是否正确。

blocks.en: Third, guardrails could extend to the complete feed, the agent’s interpretation, and its subsequent use by other agents. Systematic safety requirements, structured reasoning, and multimodal supervision provide relevant foundations [ 9 , 23 , 21 , 12 ] . For cognitive threats, these safeguards would need to assess evidential support in addition to conventional content safety, since an apparently harmless narrative can still induce a false belief. Reasoning supervision and symbolic dependency tracking could help preserve the distinction between direct evidence and inherited conclusions, and identify downstream claims affected by a later correction [ 59 , 17 ] . This could prevent repeated, confident reports from being mistaken for independent corroboration. Evaluation should examine whether such safeguards reduce error propagation while preserving useful analysis, with benign rejection and verification cost included in the comparison.
blocks.zh: 第三,护栏可以延伸到完整的饲料、毒剂的解释以及其他毒剂随后的使用。 系统的安全要求、结构化推理和多式联运监督提供了相关的基础[9、23、21、12]。 对于认知威胁,这些保障措施除了常规内容安全外,还需要评估证据支持,因为显然无害的叙述仍会诱发错误的信念。 合理监督和象征性的依赖追踪可有助于保持直接证据与继承结论之间的区别,并查明受后一更正影响的下游索赔[59、17]。 这样做可以防止重复的、有信心的报告被误认为是独立的佐证。 评价应审查这些保障措施是否在保留有用分析的同时减少误差传播,并在比较中列入良性拒绝和核查费用。

blocks.en: Finally, selective unlearning offers a direction for retaining authentic information while reducing the influence of verified cognitive errors. Work on forgetting–retention tradeoffs, representation separation, and in-context unlearning motivates studying how an agent can abandon an erroneous association without losing the underlying factual observations [ 31 , 18 , 46 ] . The intervention should match where the error persists: contextual or memory correction is relevant to the frozen agents studied here, whereas parameter-level unlearning becomes relevant if erroneous associations enter subsequent training. A useful defense would preserve accurate image understanding while preventing a corrected falsehood from reappearing through paraphrasing, repeated exposure, or downstream reuse. Whether existing unlearning techniques can achieve this selective and durable correction under multimodal manipulation remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 最后,选择性的不学习为保留真实信息提供了方向,同时减少了被核实的认知错误的影响. 有关遗忘-保留权衡、代表分离和内容内不学习的工作促使人们研究代理人如何在不丧失基本事实观察的情况下放弃错误的联系[31、18、46]。 干预应当与长期存在错误的情况相匹配:背景或内存校正与此处所研究的被冻结的代理人相关,而参数级的不学习则在错误的关联进入后续培训时相关. 有用的辩护可以保持对图像的准确理解,同时防止经纠正的假象通过抛写、反复暴露或下游再利用而再现。 现有的不学习技术能否在多式联运的操纵下实现这种有选择的和持久的纠正,仍然是一个未决问题。
